name: OI-flush reversal — fast intrabar liquidation snap (OI cross-down + washout, 15m)
rationale: MECHANISM: the fastest expression of the deleverage-washout thesis. On a 15m clock, open_interest crossing DOWN through a fitted normalized floor tags the exact liquidation event; paired with a deeply negative short-window return it isolates the mechanical snap-back that follows the last forced seller. This is distinct from the 1h/4h variants: it aims to capture the immediate 15m-to-1h rebound (very short hold ~0.04-0.25d) rather than the slower recovery, and uses cross_down (an event) not lt (a level). The other side is liquidation engines that MUST close; the solo supplies liquidity right after the cascade. SPOT long. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if the fast snap does not beat a same-return washout that ignores open_interest — otherwise it is a generic 15m knife-catch. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if net-of-fee edge evaporates once real 6bps taker fees are charged on the high 15m turnover, or if it rides on <5 cascade days.
catalyst: 15m open_interest crosses down through a fitted floor into a sharp return washout — the liquidation snap to fade long.
